column1: # Super Mario Galaxy (Switch, 2025; base game v0 + update 1.3.1 = v327680), SDK 18.3.5.
# NERD's "Hagi" Wii layer: the Wii game's PowerPC code is statically recompiled into main (hagi.config: Cpu Jit false, Statifier true), and Hagi stands in for the Wii
# hardware (GX → Vulkan with SPIR-V generated at run time, the DSP with its own ROMs in data/dsp, DVD reads from the RomFS). main's bss is about 2.9 GB (0xb964d0e8: the emulated memory).
# Renders with Vulkan: main imports 99 vk* functions, which subsdk4 (NVIDIA's Vulkan driver, on GLSLC in subsdk1) supplies; subsdk3 is NVIDIA's OpenGL driver, subsdk2 nn::pcm.
# The host implements the vk* functions on Metal itself (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m), so only main, subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie, for the WebM movies in data/video_replace) and sdk are loaded.
# Values marked "Mario's" are not measured for this game yet
# handheld: the pointer (star bits, menus, the file select) is the touch screen; docked it is the Joy-Con gyro, which the host does not have

# main imports Vulkan, not NVN: the host's Vulkan layer (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m). Hagi generates its GX shaders as SPIR-V at run time from data/database/pip/pipelineDB.pip during "Initializing system...":

# 3,089 modules with the 56 built into main, and the RomFS has no SPIR-V file, so the NSP script captures them by booting the game on the Mac (vk_capture.tsv lists the keys); vk_shaders.py translates the capture
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk; subsdk1–4 (GLSLC, nn::pcm, NVIDIA's OpenGL and Vulkan drivers) are replaced by the host's Vulkan layer and not loaded
# NPDM system resource 8 MB. Measured (DM_SVC=1, Mac, to the Star Festival): no SetHeapSize, one alias page mapped during SDK initialization; the game's memory is main's
# 2.9 GB bss (charged 443 MB), not this block (7 MB charged). So the block is 1 GB = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 256 MB heap region;
# with main's 3 GB image that is about 4 GB of address space. Footprint on the Mac: 1.9 GB (Metal 1.1 GB)

column2: Super Mario Galaxy has no NVN shaders (its SPIR-V shaders go through the Vulkan layer)
